title: hdunit (T03) adapter-gap ledger: vi.mock call sites in the vendored happy-dom suite

basis.note: T02 rewrite-report.json was not merged at T03 build time; this ledger is grounded in the vendored setup.ts and the vi.mock call sites found across tests/happy-dom/vendor/** instead. The task text mentions 'the 4 uses in upstream setup'; the vendored suite actually contains 4 vi.mock call sites total — 3 in test/setup.ts plus 1 in web-socket/WebSocket.test.ts — all enumerated below for T05 triage.

callSites.reason: Dynamic vi.mock('ws') inside the test file registers a WebSocketMock class factory. Out of T03 scope by design: the adapter only covers the setup.ts vi.mock call sites (fidelity first, no invented API). The 'ws' module is not a node builtin and its mock is test-specific; T05/WebSocket-wave must decide whether to port the mock manually (e.g. a mock.module in the wave's own setup) or register the file as a known-gap.
